result.title: Aglio e Olio (알리오 올리오)

evidences.text: Peeling and crushing garlic cloves using a garlic press and knife
Adding a palmful of coarse salt into a boiling pot of pasta water
Pouring olive oil generously into the pan
Drizzling additional olive oil over the pasta while tossing
Laddling hot pasta water into the pan with fried garlic
Transferring boiled spaghetti noodles into the pan

steps.text: Trim the garlic cloves, crush them using a garlic press, and mince finely with a knife.

evidences.text: Peeling garlic, pressing it through a garlic press, and scraping/mincing it on a cutting board

steps.text: Add a palmful of coarse salt to a pot of water to boil pasta.

evidences.text: Throwing a handful of coarse salt into the boiling water pot

steps.text: Pour olive oil into a heated frying pan, add the minced garlic, and fry until fragrant and lightly golden.

evidences.text: Adding olive oil and minced garlic into a stainless steel pan and swirling to cook the garlic

steps.text: Ladle pasta cooking water into the pan with the cooked garlic.

evidences.text: Scooping a ladle of boiling pasta water and pouring it into the sizzling pan

steps.text: Add the cooked spaghetti into the pan and stir.

evidences.text: Adding spaghetti from the pot into the pan and stirring with tongs

steps.text: Drizzle in additional olive oil and continuously toss and stir the pasta vigorously to emulsify the sauce (mantecatura).

evidences.text: Pouring olive oil onto pasta and repeatedly tossing the pan vigorously until emulsified

steps.text: Twirl the pasta and plate neatly, spooning the remaining emulsified garlic oil sauce over top.

evidences.text: Using a ladle and tongs to twist and transfer pasta onto a plate, then spooning sauce over it

unresolved: Exact amounts/measurements for garlic, olive oil, and pasta are not stated in audio, text, or subtitles.
